generated_examples.rule: Each source row becomes one research-only example with the same official URL, fact, gate and confidence. No parcel relation, allocation, planning permission, funding award or electricity connection capacity is inferred.

extra_examples.fact: Planning Data's brownfield register currently reports 37,666 records from 354 providers and says all data is from authoritative sources.
extra_examples.gate: National coverage still does not establish title control, consent or current delivery for an individual site.

extra_examples.fact: The experimental brownfield-site boundary layer is MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
extra_examples.gate: Do not use its geometry as canonical parcel geometry.

extra_examples.fact: Public, non-public, mixed and unknown are ownership classifications only.
extra_examples.gate: A classification cannot establish an option, contract, vacant possession or willingness to sell.

extra_examples.fact: Planning Data distinguishes pending-decision from permissioned and not-permissioned.
extra_examples.gate: Pending-decision must remain fail-closed until the live decision is verified.

extra_examples.fact: The dataset catalogue is useful for source discovery across planning themes.
extra_examples.gate: Dataset presence alone cannot create a parcel-level fact.

extra_examples.fact: The new plan-making regulations are in force from 25 March 2026.
extra_examples.gate: A plan being prepared under the new system is not evidence that any site is allocated.

extra_examples.fact: The 6 July 2026 reorganisation guidance is explicitly draft and subject to change.
extra_examples.gate: Do not hard-code draft transition intentions as final local-plan policy.

extra_examples.fact: The support roadmap was updated 19 May 2026 and is intended to evolve as new materials are published.
extra_examples.gate: Roadmap dates are programme-management evidence, not site status.

extra_examples.fact: The 30-month process guidance requires at least four months' public notice before plan preparation begins.
extra_examples.gate: Notice timing is a plan-process event, not a development permission.

extra_examples.fact: Gateway 1 is a self-assessment of readiness to start the 30-month preparation process.
extra_examples.gate: Passing or preparing for Gateway 1 does not allocate a site.

extra_examples.fact: Gateway 2 can produce observations and advice on evidence, conformity and soundness.
extra_examples.gate: Assessor advice can change the emerging plan and must not be treated as adopted policy.

extra_examples.fact: Gateway 3 assesses whether a plan is ready to submit for examination.
extra_examples.gate: Even successful Gateway 3 is not plan adoption or site permission.

extra_examples.fact: Site selection proceeds through identification, assessment, draft allocation decisions and confirmation/recording.
extra_examples.gate: A site must not be promoted merely because it appears in an early stage.

extra_examples.fact: Stage 1 deliberately identifies potential sites before constraints are fully assessed.
extra_examples.gate: Stage-1 inclusion is not evidence of suitability or deliverability.

extra_examples.fact: Stage 2 assesses suitability, availability, achievability and development potential.
extra_examples.gate: Assessment scores remain evidence inputs, not consent.

extra_examples.fact: Stage 4 records draft allocations, rejected sites, rationale and evidence.
extra_examples.gate: Draft allocation remains subject to consultation/examination and does not grant planning permission.

extra_examples.fact: LPAs must republish housing-requirement data at key plan stages.
extra_examples.gate: Area housing need does not establish capacity on a specific parcel.

extra_examples.fact: From 1 July 2026 national policy includes a specified additional 20% buffer case for certain authorities.
extra_examples.gate: The buffer affects decision context but does not make any site permissioned.

extra_examples.fact: The Planning Inspectorate examines whether a new-style local plan is sound and procedurally compliant.
extra_examples.gate: Examination activity is not an adopted site allocation until the plan is adopted.

extra_examples.fact: PINS procedural guidance expects the evidence base to be complete before Gateway 3.
extra_examples.gate: Completeness is plan-level readiness, not site-level approval.

extra_examples.fact: NHDF is intended to support land and infrastructure that accelerate housing.
extra_examples.gate: Eligibility or strategic fit must not be treated as an award.

extra_examples.fact: NHDF guidance includes remediation, utilities, schools, land assembly and multiple finance forms.
extra_examples.gate: Potential support does not prove a site's infrastructure is funded or deliverable.

extra_examples.fact: The programme collection groups due-diligence and enquiry materials.
extra_examples.gate: A listed programme route is not a signed agreement.

extra_examples.fact: The National Housing Bank is government-backed and designed to unlock housing and regeneration investment.
extra_examples.gate: Institutional mandate is not project finance evidence.

extra_examples.fact: NHB structured finance can include senior/mezzanine lending and infrastructure support.
extra_examples.gate: A product description is not a binding offer.

extra_examples.fact: Published product terms include 0.1% interest and a 25-year term for the described programme.
extra_examples.gate: Published terms do not establish that a specific scheme qualifies or has funding.

extra_examples.fact: Homes England groups funding, land and remediation interventions in a current collection.
extra_examples.gate: The index is discovery context only.

extra_examples.fact: The 9 July 2026 announcement describes £35m of named agreements, including a £14m Middlewood Locks infrastructure loan.
extra_examples.gate: Named project finance cannot be transferred to unrelated sites.

extra_examples.fact: The legacy webpage heat map is based on October 2025 data and is no longer updated.
extra_examples.gate: Use the current Open Data route; do not infer latest headroom from the legacy page.

extra_examples.fact: ConnectMore uses modelled asset loading versus rating and traffic-light capacity indicators.
extra_examples.gate: Modelled colour is not guaranteed connection capacity.

extra_examples.fact: NDP publishes forecast demand and generation headroom with planned interventions.
extra_examples.gate: Forecast headroom is not contractual or reserved capacity.

extra_examples.fact: SPEN uses flexibility, smart solutions and reinforcement to resolve forecast capacity needs.
extra_examples.gate: Planned intervention does not prove it will be available for a particular project's requested date.

extra_examples.fact: SPEN describes LTDS as a main source for developers' high-level initial network assessment.
extra_examples.gate: A formal project connection study remains required.

extra_examples.fact: LTDS, NDP and DFES serve different short-, medium- and long-term planning horizons.
extra_examples.gate: Do not merge different horizons into a single live headroom value.

extra_examples.fact: SP Electricity North West's final NDP and methodology are dated 30 April 2026.
extra_examples.gate: The NDP is a planning forecast, not a capacity reservation.

extra_examples.ref: SP ENW heatmap freshness and disclaimer
extra_examples.fact: The downloadable heatmap is dated 30 June 2026 and the operator requires detailed assessment for actual capacity changes.
extra_examples.gate: Fresh heatmap data still remains indicative.

extra_examples.fact: LTDS, asset viewer and embedded-capacity data support initial network assessment.
extra_examples.gate: None is a project-specific connection approval.

extra_examples.fact: The operator offers pre-application support alongside heatmaps and open data.
extra_examples.gate: Pre-application discussion does not reserve capacity.

extra_examples.fact: The digital service catalogue describes capacity that might be available for new connections.
extra_examples.gate: Potential capacity must not be stored as firm headroom.

extra_examples.fact: NGED states its latest Network Development Plans were published 1 May 2026.
extra_examples.gate: NDP planning data requires a formal connection process for exact project capacity.

extra_examples.fact: SSEN provides May 2026 LTDS capacity heatmap resources in several machine-readable formats.
extra_examples.gate: Machine-readable capacity remains planning evidence, not an accepted offer.

extra_examples.fact: SSEN's connection library includes land-rights, curtailment, reinforcement and programming guidance dated 14 July 2026.
extra_examples.gate: Guidance terms do not prove a project has secured rights, reinforcement or an accepted offer.

extra_examples.fact: The 2026 register entry is public-owned, permissioned and records 67 dwellings.
extra_examples.gate: Current completion, title and exact geometry must be verified before candidate promotion.

extra_examples.fact: The 2026 entry is deliverable and permissioned for 253 dwellings.
extra_examples.gate: Permission status alone does not show how much of the scheme remains undeveloped.

extra_examples.fact: The record has a 2026 entry date but an end date in 2019.
extra_examples.gate: End-dated records are rejected as current candidates unless authoritative current evidence supersedes the end date.

extra_examples.site: Former Unisys and Bridge Park Centre, Brent
extra_examples.fact: The record is deliverable and not-permissioned for 505 dwellings but its entry date is 2019.
extra_examples.gate: Current register, ownership and planning status must be revalidated.

extra_examples.fact: The register records 2,426 dwellings and outline permission for the remaining allocation area.
extra_examples.gate: Started phases must be removed from remaining capacity using current exact geometry.

extra_examples.fact: The 2026 entry records full permission for eight dwellings on 0.05ha.
extra_examples.gate: A small permissioned site may already be complete; live completion evidence is required.

extra_examples.fact: Search evidence records public ownership, full permission and 456 dwellings.
extra_examples.gate: Public ownership plus permission still does not prove undeveloped capacity or availability.

extra_examples.site: College of North West London Wembley
extra_examples.fact: The entity records a local-plan allocation and 155 dwellings but remains not-permissioned and has an older entry date.
extra_examples.gate: Allocation must not be promoted as consent; refresh status first.

extra_examples.site: Wembley Park Station and adjacent land
extra_examples.fact: The record lists 60 dwellings and Local Plan allocation BCSA19 but is not-permissioned.
extra_examples.gate: No planning consent or delivery score is inferred.

extra_examples.fact: The March 2026 entry records 1,989 dwellings, not-permissioned, and notes completed development has been subtracted.
extra_examples.gate: Remaining growth-area capacity still needs phase, title and exact parcel reconciliation.
